evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep moved directly into logistics probing about distance and stairs.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concerns raised by customer, so N/A.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not addressed. Rep never asked about date flexibility or offered alternative days at different price points.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Never asked for the business. Customer requested quote via email, rep confirmed email address and said 'will there be anything else I can help you with today?' — transactional close with no rate lock, no deposit mention, and no direct ask for the move.

top_strength: Rep gathered detailed logistics about the intra-building move and correctly identified the short walking distances and elevator proximity, which directly shaped the 7.5-hour estimate.
coaching_note: The call skipped step 2 (the two-concerns question) entirely and jumped straight into logistics probing. This is the single biggest structure gap — without understanding what matters to the customer first, the rep is flying blind. Before gathering details, ask: 'We talk to a lot of people every day, and most of them have one of two concerns: either the movers not showing up on time, or damage to their items. Are either of those a concern for you?'
